LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1 ATTENTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How should we respond to instructions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to list cultural foods on charts,

2. identify nouns in singular form and change them to their plural forms,

3. recite singing games based on the theme,

4. respond to lead instructions in singing games as given by the soloist,

5. work collaboratively to collect varied songs on the theme from the community,

6. organise the songs collected in the class portfolio,

7. listen to recordings about various cultural foods in class and pick out their names.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to list cultural foods on charts,
2. identify nouns in singular form and change them to their plural forms,
3. recite singing games based on the theme,
4. respond to lead instructions in singing games as given by the soloist,
5. work collaboratively to collect varied songs on the theme from the community,
6. organise the songs collected in the class portfolio,
7. listen to recordings about various cultural foods in class and pick out their names.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is enhanced as the learner contributes to group decision making when working with

peers to collect varied songs on the theme from the community.

• Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to recordings about various

cultural foods.

Values:
● Responsibility: This is enhanced as the learner exhibits a self-driven attitude when organising the songs collected in the class

portfolio.

● Unity: This is developed as the learner cooperates with peers to collect varied songs on the theme from the community.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural awareness: This is enhanced as the learner is made aware of culture when collecting and listening to cultural songs from

the community.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of attentive listening to their learning of listening skills in English.
